chronology.claim_label_if_scored: outcome-separated component-ablation test of a pre-existing representation

scoring.primary: directional accuracy over every reported comparison that matches a frozen component prediction
scoring.regression: score shortest-context or easiest-stratum retention when the paper reports the required matched comparison
scoring.missingness: mark a prediction unscored when the paper does not report the required matched result
scoring.independence_guardrail: nested benchmarks and strata remain one source-level test
